calendar_policy: Preserve reference month/day in an earlier year, source SQL day offsets and boundary operators; shift explicit question dates consistently, including leap-year first-60-day endpoints.
sampling_policy: Seed-42 hash partition of real anchor IDs across QA/support splits; historical eligibility; approximately balanced SQL-defined outcome strata; spread anchors/seasons/numeric values; no repeated bound SQL; record scarce strata and never fabricate/replace undefined results with zero.
qa_split_policy: Preserve question IDs and original split membership; replace prediction anchors, canonical wording and actual SQL labels. Nonprediction QA unchanged. Anchor IDs are disjoint across splits; this is not an unseen-template split.
head_training_policy: Train on support/train, select on support/validation, and keep original qa/test as the current main test. Revised support/test is reserved for separate final evaluation, never per-query adaptation.
support_count_policy: Up to ten per parent. If a classification role exceeds 60/40 after real candidate selection, downsample the majority toward 50/50 while retaining five examples per parent where available; see audit/downsampled_support.json.
original_qa_prediction_policy: Outcome-stratified diagnostic evaluation, not natural-population prevalence. Rebuilt prediction paraphrase lists are empty to avoid stale entity/season aliases.
comparison_policy: Rebuild this domain 05 and affected 01. Retrain holdouts that use this domain as source, then rerun target 07. Existing models/results retain old provenance; unchanged reasoning QA is reusable.
test_support_policy: Final temporal evaluation instances only; not adaptation data. Existing qa/test remains the current experiment cohort.
